defs.def: to make a young bird, fish, insect, etc. come out of an egg 使（小鸟、小鱼、小虫等）孵出

ex.s: Female Australian superb fairy wrens were found to repeat one sound over and over again while hatching their eggs.
ex.t: 研究发现，澳大利亚雌性华丽细尾鹩莺在孵化鸟蛋时会一遍又一遍地重复同一种声音。

defs.def: to create a plan or an idea, especially in secret 策划；（尤指）密谋
an opening or a door in the deck of a ship or the bottom of an aircraft, through which goods to be carried are passed （船甲板或飞机底部装货物的）舱口

ex.s: Japan had hatched a plot to launch a surprise attack on Pearl Harbor, so the attack began without warning and without declaring war on the United States.
ex.t: 日本策划了一个阴谋，要对珍珠港发动突袭，所以这次袭击是在没有警告和未对美国宣战的情况下开始的。

defs.def: an opening in a wall between two rooms, especially a kitchen and a dining room, through which food can be passed （尤指厨房和餐厅之间供传递食物的）两室之间的小窗口
a door in an aircraft or a spacecraft （飞机或宇宙飞船的）舱门
an opening or a door in a floor or ceiling （地面或天花板的）开口，门，盖子
